profiles.control_policy: Controls must span both axes and the usable plate footprint; no control may be moved after holdout evaluation.
profiles.holdout_policy: Holdouts are frozen before solving and excluded from fit.
profiles.normalizer: target-frame diagonal across frozen control+holdout extent
profiles.model_escalation: Affine/projective escalation requires separate preregistration and documented scan distortion; failure of similarity fit is not permission to overfit.

profiles.control_policy: Controls must be survey/architectural correspondences distributed across the temple footprint.
profiles.holdout_policy: At least three holdouts spanning distinct plan sectors; excluded from fit.
profiles.normalizer: target-frame diagonal across frozen control+holdout extent
profiles.model_escalation: No projective model without evidence that the published digital image itself is perspective-distorted.
